researcher_notes: 11 files (9 official VDI-2198-format datasheets in German/English + 1 16pp company-wide 'Linde-MATIC range' brochure not separately extracted this pass due to time budget, listed for a future run). VDI 2198 is a German industry-standard forklift datasheet layout (numbered rows 1.1-10.7) shared across Linde/STILL/Jungheinrich-style OEM sheets -- very information-dense and reliably structured once the row-number pattern is recognized. All 11 corresponding DB base models already existed with literally only base_model_id/name/product_type/last_updated populated (all real spec fields NULL) -- pure enrichment throughout, no new products. CONFIRMED CROSS-REFERENCE: P-MATIC and L-MATIC (BR133) datasheets both print 'Hersteller: LINDE/BALYO' and describe 'Geo-Navigation "Driven by BALYO"' -- this independently confirms the Linde<->Balyo OEM relationship already known from the Balyo-side datasheets processed earlier this run (Balyo TUGGY=Linde Tractor, LOWY=Linde Stacker, REACHY=Linde Reach, VEENY=Linde VNA base_model_names) -- not a new company-relationship finding, just a second-source confirmation, noted for completeness. Several multi-configuration tables (C-MATIC 10/15, L-MATIC AC 1.2t/1.6t, K-MATIC/R-MATIC mast-height variants) were collapsed to one DB row per the existing product naming (no separate DB rows exist per config) -- CONSERVATIVE (lowest-capability) values used for K.O. fields per the matrix policy, higher-capability configs noted in field_sources. 'Linde R-MATIC k (R-MATIC 17 k)' source file (DE_tb_r_matic_k_5190) only yielded a features/options list on the pages read (p.2-3), not a numeric VDI table -- likely present on a later page not captured this pass; flagged as PARTIALLY extracted, worth a follow-up re-read of pp.4-6 of that specific file. ADDENDUM (full-batch continuation run, same calendar day): the previously-deferred 16pp company brochure ('EN_p_robotics_en_a_0216.pdf') was now processed. It is a qualitative product-line overview (application-matrix style, e.g. 'Pick & drop at low levels' / 'Bar code scanning' mapped to which MATIC model handles which use case) with almost no additional numeric specs beyond what the 11 individual VDI-2198 datasheets already provided -- no new fields extracted for existing products. NEW PRODUCT NAME FLAG (insufficient data to create a row): the brochure's application matrix (p.15) lists 'T-MATIC' as a distinct model name alongside L-MATIC/L-MATIC AC, implying a Linde-MATIC tow-tractor/tugger model not currently in the DB and not covered by any of this batch's other 11 datasheet files -- but no numeric specs (payload, speed, towing capacity) are given anywhere in this brochure for it, so no product row was created; flagged for a future dedicated search for a T-MATIC-specific datasheet. The brochure also explicitly confirms (does not newly establish) the Linde↔BALYO relationship already documented from this batch's Balyo/Linde cross-references: 'Linde Material Handling and BALYO are merging their technologies and strengths to develop innovative robotic material handling solutions' (p.16).
